question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH country_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as customer_count
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
),
country_sales AS (
    SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) as total_sales
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.Country
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cs.total_sales) as median_total_sales
FROM country_sales cs
JOIN country_customer_counts cc ON cs.Country = cc.Country
WHERE cc.customer_count > 4
